Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

bank — a place that keeps money. Example: The bank is on the corner.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: There are two parks near my building.
museum — a place with objects to look at. Example: First, visit the museum.
cinema — a place where you watch films. Example: There are two cinemas in my town.
restaurant — a place where you eat a meal. Example: There are a lot of restaurants here.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There is a ...
• There are two ...
• Is there a ...?
• Are there any ...?
• It is on the corner.

elements.content: Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
In my town there is a bank, a park and a museum. There are two cinemas and a lot of restaurants. The park is near the museum.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Is there a museum in your town? B: Yes, there is. A: Are there any cinemas? B: Yes, there are two.
